use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: Exchange IFF/SIF modes and codes to insure commonality of data between the IUs.

goal.raw_text: Exchange IFF/SIF modes and codes to insure commonality of data between the IUs.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is the JU with R² for the Air or Surface track.
The C2 JU has correlated local sensor data.
IFF/SIF valid data locally held for that track.
The applicable mode indicators are set.
The C2 JU manually initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message with the applicable mode indicators set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU manually initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message with the applicable mode indicators set when requesting update of IFF/SIF data.

claims.content: The C2 JU manually initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message with the applicable mode indicators set.
R² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message will respond by initiating a J3.XC1 message regardless of the No Data status.
NonR² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit will respond by initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message if valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
The JU with R² reports IFF/SIF data in conjunction with periodic surveillance data.
JUs without R² are responsible for monitoring such data and only reporting different data with the J7.5 message.
The JU with R² can be assumed to be reporting the most current data available on the interface.
If an R² unit receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message has No Data status, it still responds by initiating a J3.XC1 message. Exit: The J3.XC1 message is initiated.

If a nonR² unit receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message does not hold valid local data (nonzero codes) for the requested mode(s), it does not initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message. Exit: No J7.5 (ACT = 1) difference report is generated by that unit.

When updating local data to agree with remote data, if the data is a Mode II code, the local data is not changed to agree with remote data; instead, decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data. Exit: The local data is decorrelated and a new track number is assigned.
Units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message have responded by transmitting their local data codes.
R² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message have responded by initiating a J3.XC1 message regardless of the No Data status.
NonR² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit have responded by initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message if valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
Local data has been changed to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code.
In the case of Mode II code, local data has been decorrelated from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data.
The operator alert has been cleared (any mode).
